entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of absolute garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To best assist you, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a fault! It doesn't track my heart rate properly. It's off by like 30 beats a minute. The thing is useless.
I see, I can certainly understand your frustration with that. That definitely doesn't sound right. I can quickly walk you through a calibration reset, which often resolves sensor inaccuracies.

No! I **don't have time** to be your IT guy. I bought a product that was supposed to work. I **just want money** back. A full **refund**. Are you going to process that or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand completely. I want to get this sorted out for you. Let me just pull up your account and review the return eligibility. Can I get your email address?
It's sarah.vip@email.com. And you better believe I'll be leaving reviews about this faulty product and your service if this isn't handled properly.
Thank you for that, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse and it was delivered 20 days ago, on December 15th. Let me just check our policy.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 20, you are well within that window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now.
So that's it? You're giving me a refund? No more troubleshooting nonsense?

That's correct. I am processing it now. I'll email a pre-paid return label to you in the next few minutes. Additionally, I see you're a VIP member with us at VeloFit. For the inconvenience and frustration this has caused, I've also added a $50 credit to your account for any future purchase. We truly apologize for the experience you had.
Oh. Well... okay. A full refund and a credit is acceptable. Thank you. Send the label over.
I've just sent it. It should be in your inbox now. Once we receive the returned band, your refund will be issued to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can do for you today, Sarah?
Great. Thank you for your patience, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a good rest of your day.
